findings.current: The massive hunk of steel, weighing dozens of tons, smashed and burst through everything in its path.
findings.defect: “Burst through” makes the airplane the thing bursting through obstacles, while the source says it crushed and burst apart everything blocking its path.
findings.rationale: The transitive verbs 부수고 터트렸다 describe what the airplane did to the monsters and other obstacles, directly causing the blood and severed limbs in the next sentence.
findings.replacement: The massive hunk of steel, weighing dozens of tons, crushed and burst apart everything in its path.

findings.current: If I ever went to the United States, maybe some huge Yankee bros would come up to me with beer bottles in hand and greet me like an old friend.
findings.defect: “Like an old friend” adds longstanding personal familiarity absent from the source, which only imagines strangers approaching and acting as though they recognize or know him.
findings.rationale: 알은척을 하다 means to acknowledge someone or act as though one knows them; it does not imply the intimacy or shared history of old friends.
findings.replacement: If I ever went to the United States, maybe some huge Yankee bros would come up to me with beer bottles in hand and act like they knew me.

summary: Faithful overall, with two localized minor defects affecting the crash mechanism and the degree of imagined familiarity.
